kong: Kanghi as a youth had attended a school in Hong Kong, and while there had made the acquaintance of several half Chinese half English lads.

They belt the earth, these places, but they cluster in the tropics, with its darkened peoples: in Hong Kong and Anam, in Borneo and Rhodesia, in Sierra Leone and Nigeria, in Panama and Havana--these are the El Dorados toward which the world powers stretch itching palms.
